messages:
Jordan: Quick follow-up from RFC: router fallback + quotas interplay — noticed some odd client-level fairness when fallback to smaller models kicks in.
Priya: Saw that too on staging during synthetic probe. throughput spike + tenant lost headroom, fallbacks more likely.
Sam: Can you paste the ingress logs? suspecting ordering in fair-scheduler vs route-picker.
Jordan: log snippet:
```
[ingress] route=primary->fallback model=m-8b q=timeout tenant=acct-42 tokens=1200
fairness: leased=0 available=2
```
Priya: aha — fairness thought tenant was out of leases because fallback calls consume from shared pool? That pool is per-model-group.
Lena: Important: fallback should not borrow from per-model exclusive pool; else we penalize already-deprived tenants.
Ria: Proposed fix in RFC follow-up: when route-picker opts fallback, map to the same tenant budget as original route (use virtual model tag). thoughts?
Sam: +1, but how about cost accounting? we need to preserve per-model metrics for billing.
Jordan: suggestion: dual-accounting — charge fallback requests to original tenant/model for quotas but emit model-level telemetry for billing. simple mapping table.
Priya: ops question: does this break autoscaler heuristics which look at model usage? If we hide usage, autoscaler underprovisions.
Lena: Autoscaler can read emitted model telemetry separate from quota ledger. separation of concerns.
InfraBot: deploy-check: need schema update to QuotaLedger: add virtual_model_id (opt)
Ria: I'll sketch the ledger patch and a migration that sets virtual_model_id for fallback routes.
Sam: Also consider fairness scheduling: when fallbacks are triggered, we should score them lower so they don't preempt primary route requests.
Jordan: agree — add penalty multiplier for route-origin mismatch, e.g., score *= 0.7 for fallback-originated requests.
Priya: let's cap penalty so very small requests still pass, otherwise tiny bursts might starve others.
Lena: Action items: Ria->ledger patch, Jordan->scheduler penalty PR, Priya->run synthetic load with mixed fallbacks, Sam->telemetry contract doc.
Sam: timeline? two week runway?
Ria: I can get ledger patch and migration in 4 days.
Jordan: Scheduler PR would be 5-7 days. Priya can start tests tomorrow.
Lena: If no objections by EOD Friday, we'll merge staging-only flags behind feature gate.
Jordan: pinging @eng-sre for rollout guidance :eng-sre: 
Tomas (eng-sre): noted, will prepare canary rollout steps and monitor token-level latencies.
Jordan: thanks — keeping this thread as single source for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
